main_measure.name: mean 10-bar forward return on short bars minus mean over all bars (non-overlapping blocks)

decided_by: Fewer than 90% of active (non-zero forecast) bars are short bars with SMA50 below SMA200 (raw spread < 0), so the config does not trade the plan's situation on its side.
reading: Situation taken as last_history_value (SMA50-SMA200)/SMA200 < 0 with forecast < 0 on every bar with a non-zero forecast.
